name: Miguel Bombarda Simultaneous Openings
description: Porto's artiest street celebrates its 19th anniversary as dozens of galleries simultaneously launch their new exhibitions. It's a fantastic evening art crawl and a cornerstone of the city's cultural calendar.
longDescription:
The Miguel Bombarda Simultaneous Openings is an annual event in Porto's Bombarda Art District, marking the district's 19th anniversary in 2026. This cultural fixture involves numerous art galleries along Rua Miguel Bombarda and its surrounding streets, each launching new exhibitions on the same evening. The event serves as a collective showcase for contemporary art in Porto, presenting a diverse range of artistic expressions from local and international artists.

Visitors can expect an evening dedicated to art exploration, moving between various gallery spaces. The atmosphere is generally lively, with people strolling along the street and engaging with the new works on display. The event typically attracts a broad audience, including art enthusiasts, collectors, and those interested in Porto's cultural offerings. Galleries are situated within the urban fabric of the Bombarda district, offering a varied experience as one moves from one exhibition to the next.

Admission to all participating galleries is free of charge, and no prior booking is required. The Bombarda Art District is centrally located and easily accessible; it is approximately a 10-minute walk from Aliados metro station or a 5-minute walk from the Palácio de Cristal bus stops. The event is suitable for all ages.
